entry.summary: 对于 set $X$, $S subset.eq cal(P)\(X\)$ 被称为 $X$ 上的一个 $sigma$-algebra, if 其满足: + $nothing in X$\; + closed under complement: if $E in S$ then $X\\E in S$\; + closed under countable union: if $E_1\,E_2\,dots.h.c in S$ then $union.big_(k = 1)^oo E_k in S$. 如果第三条并不满足, 而是只满足 closed under finite union, 则称 $S$ 是 $X$ 上的一个 [algebra of sets]. 当然, $sigma$-algebra 是比 algebra 严格更强的条件.
